name: Global Coupons for WooCommerce
author: Eyup Gulsen

sections.description:
Global Coupons for WooCommerce lets you create smart, dynamic, and condition-based coupons that appear to each customer only when they meet specific criteria — such as first order, total spend, or years of membership.

Customers can easily view all their available coupons on My Account → Coupons, see which ones are active, inactive, or used, and apply them directly to their cart.

🎯 Highlights
– Automatically control coupon visibility and availability per user
– Works seamlessly with the default WooCommerce coupon system
– Show personalized coupon lists under My Account → Coupons
– Track coupon usage and activity with built-in reports
– Translate or rename all frontend labels and colors without coding

🪄 Perfect for:
– Rewarding first-time buyers
– Creating loyalty-based or spend-based discounts
– Seasonal or date-based campaigns
– Exclusive “For You Only” offers
– Review or engagement-driven coupons

🚀 Main Features

1. Dynamic Restrictions
Create availability rules for your coupons:
– First Order
– Minimum Number of Orders
– Total Spent Amount
– Specific Customers (emails)
– Number of Reviews
– Active Date Range
– Years of Membership

2. Smart Coupon Display
Users see only the coupons they are eligible for.
Inactive ones show a “Deactive” status with clear reason indicators.

3. Simple Coupon Management
Create Global Coupons just like standard ones — only difference is a GC_ prefix.
You can also convert existing WooCommerce coupons into global ones easily.

4. Admin Reports & Insights
– Activation Report – view who qualifies for which coupons.
– Order Report – track where global coupons were used.

5. Fully Customizable
– Change frontend texts, button labels, and colors
– Translate tab names and coupon table headers
– Responsive layout fits all WooCommerce themes

🧩 Example Use Cases

  • Give 10% off only to users with at least 3 orders
  • Create a “Welcome Back” coupon for users inactive for a while
  • Reward loyal users who’ve spent over $500
  • Offer birthday or anniversary coupons based on registration year
sections.installation:
1. Upload the global-coupons-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or upload the ZIP directly via WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu
  3. Visit the new Global Coupons section in your admin menu
  4. Start creating smart, personalized coupon rules instantly
sections.faq:
Does it work with the latest WooCommerce version?

Yes, fully tested with WordPress 6.8.3 and WooCommerce 9.x.

Can I still use regular WooCommerce coupons?

Absolutely. Global Coupons only apply to coupons starting with the prefix GC_, so normal coupons remain unaffected.

Can customers see inactive coupons?

Yes, they’ll appear as Deactive, helping customers understand what conditions they need to meet.

Can I customize the look or text?

Yes, all visible text and colors can be changed from the Settings page.

Can I request a new condition or feature?

Yes! Email us at globalcoupons@mrebabi.com — we welcome improvement ideas.
